mapper.sql: rp.id, rp.employee_id, e.name AS employee_name, rp.amount, rp.message, s.name AS sender_name, rp.read_flag, rp.created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO red_packet (employee_id, amount, message, sender_id) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{amount}, #{message}, #{senderId})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM red_packet rp JOIN employee e ON e.id = rp.employee_id JOIN employee s ON s.id = rp.sender_id WHERE rp.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM red_packet rp JOIN employee e ON e.id = rp.employee_id JOIN employee s ON s.id = rp.sender_id WHERE rp.employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY rp.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE red_packet SET read_flag = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND employee_id = #{employeeId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM red_packet WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND read_flag = 0
